title: ScalarLines coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-scalar-coordinates]. Scalar line coordinates for a coefficient map $a:c\to c'$ commuting with integral maps consist of the ordinary first-line isomorphism fixed by scalar associativity, and power isomorphisms for every nonnegative exponent fixed by the ordinary scalar tensorators and unit. The source scalar arrow $T_XJ_{f,c,d}\to J_{f,c',d}T_Y$ is the inverse derived scalar tensorator followed by the canonical scalar pullback comparison tensor the shifted line map determined by these coordinates.
